message.reasoning_content:
Let's compute. Sum: 17-4+23+8 = 44. Words: pear, apple, pear, plum, Apple, apple, fig, plum → unique case-sensitive sorted: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum → 5 words.

Let me create the files.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "mkdir -p out
python3 - <<'EOF'
nums = [int(x) for x in open('data/a.txt').read().split()]
s = sum(nums)
open('out/sum.txt','w').write(str(s)+"\n")
words = sorted(set(open('data/b.txt').read().split()))
open('out/words.txt','w').write("\n".join(words)+"\n")
open('out/notes.txt','w').write(f"sum of integers in data/a.txt is {s}; data/b.txt has {len(words)} unique words.\n")
print(s, words)
EOF
echo "=== sum.txt ==="; cat out/sum.txt
echo "=== words.txt ==="; cat out/words.txt
echo "=== notes.txt ==="; cat out/notes.txt"}
